description: This file defines the BodyParsingMiddleware class for the Slim Framework, responsible for parsing different types of request bodies (JSON, XML, form data) and making the parsed data accessible within the request processing pipeline.

classes.name: BodyParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles parsing of request bodies based on content type, supporting JSON, XML, and form-encoded data, for use within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with optional custom body parsers and registers default parsers.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an incoming server request, parses the body if necessary, and passes the request to the next handler.

methods.name: registerBodyParser
methods.description: Registers a custom parser for a specific media type.

methods.name: hasBodyParser
methods.description: Checks if a parser exists for a specific media type.

methods.name: getBodyParser
methods.description: Retrieves the parser callable for a given media type.

methods.name: registerDefaultBodyParsers
methods.description: Sets up default parsers for JSON, URL-encoded, and XML media types.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Attempts to parse the request body based on its media type.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Extracts the media type from the request's Content-Type header.

methods.name: disableXmlEntityLoader
methods.description: Disables or enables the XML entity loader, considering PHP version compatibility.
